overview: The board approved a special permit for the reconstruction of a home on Terrace Road and granted six-month extensions for developments on Boston Avenue and Spring Street. Members also coordinated upcoming topical hearings for a large-scale 40B comprehensive permit project at 970 Fellsway.

items.title: 290 Salem Street
items.summary: Continued the petition for a residential structure to January 25, 2024, as the applicant is still coordinating with the Community Development Board.

items.title: 590 Boston Avenue Extension
items.summary: Approved a six-month extension, until July 12, 2024, for a previously granted variance and special permit for a five-story multi-family building.

items.title: 0 Spring Street Extension
items.summary: Approved a six-month extension for a special permit to construct a single-family dwelling on a vacant lot.

items.title: 44 Terrace Road Reconstruction
items.summary: Approved a special permit for the reconstruction of a non-conforming single-family dwelling following revisions that reduced the structure's massing and improved neighbor views.

items.title: 970 Fellsway 40B Update
items.summary: Continued the comprehensive permit hearing for a 289-unit residential project to January 30, 2024, after reviewing updates on traffic study counts and peer review scheduling.

items.title: 120 Winthrop Street Fence Variance
items.summary: Continued a variance request for a corner-lot fence to January 25, 2024, to allow the applicant time to consult with the Building Commissioner on safety compliance.

items.title: 66 Irving Street Fence Variance
items.summary: Continued the petition for a fence height variance to January 25, 2024, because the applicant was not present.

items.title: 38 Pearl Street Conversion
items.summary: Continued a use variance request to convert a single-family dwelling into a two-family to February 29, 2024, while the applicant revises plans and prepares a legal brief.

items.title: Administrative Business and Minutes
items.summary: Approved minutes from November 2 and November 30, 2023, and acknowledged several personnel changes within the Community Development and Building departments.
